name: create_social_clip
description: Create stock-footage social media clips (B-roll + voiceover + subtitles + background music) via MoneyPrinterTurbo. Use for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, faceless YouTube, or 'b-roll video' requests. NOT for AI-generated video from a text prompt — use generate_video for Grok/Sora/Veo AI animation instead. Triggers: 'social clip', 'b-roll', 'reel', 'tiktok video', 'shorts video', 'faceless video', 'stock footage video with narration'. Output saves to stash for web UI playback.

subject.description: Topic or keyword for the clip. AI writes the script and picks stock footage from this. Example: 'french bulldog care tips', 'morning productivity habits'

script.description: Optional custom narration script. If omitted, MoneyPrinterTurbo generates one from the subject.

aspect_ratio.description: Video shape. Default 9:16 (vertical TikTok/Reels/Shorts). Use 16:9 for YouTube landscape.

voice.description: TTS voice name. Default from MONEYPRINTER_VOICE in env (fallback en-CA-LiamNeural-Male). Examples: en-US-JennyNeural-Female, en-GB-RyanNeural-Male

clip_duration.description: Seconds per stock clip segment before switching. Default 5.

paragraph_number.description: Number of narration paragraphs (1-10). More paragraphs = longer script. Default 1 (MPT server default).

match_materials_to_script.description: Align stock clip order to script beats instead of random. Default false (MPT server default).

bgm_type.description: Background music mode: 'random' (default), '' (none), or 'custom' (requires bgm_file on MPT server).

video_count.description: Batch render count (usually 1). MPT returns multiple final-*.mp4 variants when >1.

save.description: Download finished video and save to stash (default true).

availability.setup_hint: Set MONEYPRINTER_API_URL in the active mode env file to your MoneyPrinterTurbo server base URL.
